name: Yoshizaki Makoto
source: A cheerful and athletic girl who hates cheating. She is a good dancer who rivals Riara in skills. A highly emotional girl raised in a big family, she is very open-minded. She has a good fashion sense, but is lacking in the make-up area. She is not good with romance, and is single-minded when she falls in love.
